newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight sees light inquiry.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight sees light inquiry.

text.p: A few new inquiries were heard in the London sugar freight market on Tuesday.

Glencore had 12,500-14,000 tonnes bagged sugar Thailand/Umm Qasr prompt and Amerop 8,000 bulk N Brazil to Fray Bentos also prompt. The few fixtures reported included CSR 17,000 tonnes bulk 15-25 Jan Queensland/Japan said by brokers to be at $19 or $19.50.
E D and F Man were said to have fixed on subjects 13,000-14,000 bagged sugar Antwerp Umm Qasr prompt.
